en:
What's up, Shuichi? Do you wanna join
the student council too?
<CLT=cltMIND>Should I hang out with Angie for a while?

Nyahahaha! The student council welcomes
any and all!

<CLT=cltMIND>After I declined her offer to join,
Angie and I spent some time together...
<CLT=cltMIND>Angie and I grew a little closer today.
